item.description: The run_process and open_process functions don't accept Python 3.9+ subprocess arguments like 'user', 'group', 'umask', and 'extra_groups' which are expected by the tests.
item.contract: Update the function signatures of run_process and open_process to accept and pass through the additional subprocess arguments: user, group, umask, and extra_groups. The parameters should be forwarded to the underlying subprocess calls in the backend implementations.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_subprocesses.py::test_py39_arguments should pass for both asyncio and trio backends.

item.description: The socket path validation doesn't properly handle null bytes in abstract Unix socket paths, causing ValueError exceptions when validating paths.
item.contract: Modify the socket path validation logic in setup_unix_local_socket to properly validate and sanitize paths, particularly for abstract Unix domain sockets, ensuring that null bytes are rejected and proper error messages are provided.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_sockets.py related to abstract socket paths with null bytes should pass.

item.description: The Lock and Semaphore classes don't accept the 'fast_acquire' parameter that the tests expect, causing TypeError exceptions.
item.contract: Update the constructors for Lock and Semaphore classes to accept a 'fast_acquire' boolean parameter. The parameter should control whether the acquisition process yields control to the event loop when there's no contention.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_synchronization.py::TestLock::test_fast_acquire and tests/test_synchronization.py::TestSemaphore::test_fast_acquire should pass for both asyncio and trio backends.
